title: Cline times while truth diverges in chasms of invented geographic boundaries. Selections of gospel flow in Adaptations of hunger. need to be right not
summary: Cline times while truth diverges in chasms of invented geographic boundaries. Selections of gospel flow in Adaptations of hunger. need to be right not get it right Creating boundaries in ranges of possibility #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Cline times
while truth
diverges
in chasms
of invented
geographic
boundaries.
Selections
of gospel
flow in
Adaptations of
hunger.
  need to be right
not get it right
Creating boundaries
in ranges of
   possibility
#smallpoems
